name: Wise brand-only social share card by wise.com
description: A 1200×630 brand-only share card: a flat field of Wise's bright lime green fills the whole canvas with no imagery, gradient or copy, and the dark forest-green wordmark — flag glyph plus lowercase 'wise' — sits alone at the optical centre. The card relies entirely on the two-colour brand pairing and heavy geometric letterforms, letting roughly 80% negative space make the mark the unmistakable focal point. It reads as a deliberate pause in a feed: bold, flat, instantly attributable, with no competing hierarchy beyond one centred lockup.
